name: sh.crispy/crispy
description: Full LinkedIn access for AI agents: leads, messaging, and campaigns with safe limits built in.

environmentVariables.name: CRISPY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Crispy API key, from https://crispy.sh/dashboard/api-keys

environmentVariables.name: CRISPY_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Crispy endpoint the bridge proxies to. Defaults to https://crispy.sh/api/mcp

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token: your Crispy API key from the dashboard
